operator.finite_definition: Already executed at each map native NSIDE: a_plus/minus_lm=Omega_pix*sum_selected_native_pixel_centres[(Q +/- iU)*conjugate(_+/-2 Y_lm)], ell2,3; E=-(a_plus+a_minus)/2 and B=i*(a_plus-a_minus)/2. This task consumes the saved outputs and never evaluates those pixel sums.
operator.support: Exactly30021 of49152 NSIDE64 parent cells and all native children. Saved S7=S4=original selected support; FULL7 indices and SMICA support reference must match. No remask, expansion or downgrade.
operator.convention: Galactic COSMO; no U flip; K_CMB. Canonical order E2[5],E3[7],B2[5],B3[7]; each m0 real followed by sqrt(2)Re(a_lm),-sqrt(2)Im(a_lm), ascending m.
operator.meaning: Finite masked delivered-map spin2 coordinates. Shared support/convention does not establish identical beam, transfer, quadrature resolution, noise response or continuum/true-sky E/B recovery. No smoothing, beam/pixel-window correction, colour/gain correction, calibration or deconvolution.
operator.tensor_scope: All E2/B2(3,3) and E3/B3(3,3,3) entries, including off-diagonal and mixed-index/permuted components. No absolute-value, diagonal-only, eigenvalue-only or scalar replacement.

smica_condition.assumption: Only this qualified PR3 R3.00 full body/profile admits row p=NESTED pixel p while FIRSTPIX/LASTPIX/INDXSCHM/OBJECT are absent. Inherit the reviewed exact-product interpretation, not generic missing-card acceptance or modern-format compliance.
smica_condition.benchmark: SMICA itself is the one component-separation benchmark among8 maps. It is not a GHz frequency, ground truth, independent observation or noise-free CMB. A SMICA-relative difference is not estimated foreground contamination.

method.full_carrier: Stack C(8,24), retaining exact binary64 saved rows/tensors and coordinate labels. First7 rows, support, anchors and prior four-target results are copied unchanged.
method.contrasts: D143_i=C_i-C_143 and DSMICA_i=C_i-C_SMICA, both(8,24), with corresponding complete STF differences. Keep all signed coordinates; own-reference rows exactly zero. These are delivered-map contrasts only.
method.fixed_anchors: Use saved anchor_E and anchor_B, both12x2, with columns D143_30 and D143_353. Fix reference143, order30/353, unweighted Euclidean E objective and s2/s1>1e-8. Do not tune anchors/weights/reference on SMICA.
method.old_targets: Copy accepted44/70/100/217 E/B targets, coefficients, predictions and residuals from FULL7 unchanged. Verify identities against saved carriers but do not rerun those fits.
method.new_target: For SMICA only: y_E=D143_SMICA[:12],y_B=D143_SMICA[12:]; alpha=argmin||y_E-A_E alpha||_2 using float64 lstsq,rcond=None. B_hat=A_B alpha; r_E=y_E-A_E alpha; r_B=y_B-B_hat. Also save absolute B_hat_SMICA=C_143[B12]+B_hat. Only target E enters fit; all12 signed B coordinates are predicted/compared.
method.conditioning: Preserve saved singular values/ratio0.09373936331209766 and check the new load against them. Nonfinite/inconsistent inputs HOLD. If s2/s1<=1e-8, retain carriers, emit ANCHOR_FIT_ILL_CONDITIONED and absent/null predictions; never zero-fill or relax threshold. The full prediction deliverable then remains unmet.
method.prediction_tensors: Use identical two coefficients on complete143-relative B2/B3 anchor tensors; retain full predicted and residual tensors for all5 targets and SMICA absolute prediction. Check equivalence to canonical decoding.
method.new_cross_terms: O[i,j,a,b]=C[i,a]*C[j,b], shape(8,8,24,24), units K_CMB^2. Preserve all E/B and ell2/ell3 cross-coordinate blocks. This is an uncentered deterministic outer product of fixed observed numbers, not estimated covariance or a stochastic moment.
method.cross_summary: G[k,i,j]=sum_a_in_block_k C[i,a]*C[j,a] for E2,E3,B2,B3, shape(4,8,8). H[ell,i,j]=sum_m C[i,Eell,m]*C[j,Bell,m], ell2,3, shape(2,8,8); H generally need not be symmetric. These signed contractions expose component agreement/cancellation hidden by norm-only summaries. Cross-ell outer products retain the declared frame; no rotation/parity inference is required.
method.holdout_scope: Algorithmic E-to-B holdout only: shared sky, mask leakage, component-separation dependence and cross-map noise remain unmodelled. A nonzero residual describes failure of this fixed finite linear rule to match coordinates, not null rejection, physical-law falsification or statistical independence.
method.scalar_scope: Keep prior seven-frequency computational image unchanged. Do not add an eight-frequency CDF or replace vectors/tensors with scalar Q/Pi/F; SMICA is not a frequency.
